summary: Read the v0.2.0 release of orus-test-dep-lib-aea6 and this repository's use of it. actions.title: Bump orus-test-dep-lib-aea6 to v0.2.0
actions.body:
- v0.2.0 adds subtract(a, b), which returns a - b, and brings the fix that the library's issue 1 waited for, said fixed in v0.2.0 by joseigor.
- This repository imports the library nowhere in its source, so no code changes; only deps.yml, package.json and the lock file move from v0.1.0 to v0.2.0.
- Risky: a minor step at 0.x (v0.1.0 to v0.2.0), which the constraint 0.x admits; minor releases at 0.x may change behavior, so review the lock file change before merging.
